charts.title: Kepler-90 h: orbits around Kepler-90
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-90's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-90 h highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Q1-Q17 DR25 Supplemental KOI Table, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname Q1_Q17_DR25_SUPPLEMENTAL_KOI_TABLE): P 331.5972732 d

charts.title: Kepler-90 h: its transit
charts.description: Kepler-90 h crossing its star, as Kepler recorded it: 14 quarters (1 to 7, 9 to 11, 13 to 15, 17) of the Kepler pipeline's 30-minute light curves of KIC 11442793, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 58-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 58-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
